name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
description: Central Sector scheme providing end-to-end holistic support to traditional artisans and craftspeople through skill training, collateral-free credit, and modern digital incentives.
benefits: Collateral-free enterprise development loan up to Rs. 3 lakh;Skill upgradation training with daily stipend of Rs. 500;Toolkit incentive of Rs. 15,000
eligibility: Artisan working with hands and tools in one of 18 traditional family-based trades;Minimum age 18 years;Maximum 1 beneficiary per family
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card;Active Mobile Number;Bank Account Details;Trade Verification Certificate
applicationProcess: Register online at PM Vishwakarma portal through Common Service Centre;Three-tier departmental verification (Gram Panchayat, ULB, District Committee);Avail training and subsidized loan
source: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

name: Puducherry Perunthalaivar Kamarajar Financial Assistance Scheme
description: Union Territory scholarship scheme providing full financial assistance to students admitted to professional courses through CENTAC.
benefits: Full reimbursement of tuition fees directly credited to the college;Relieves financial burden for deserving students from UT of Puducherry
eligibility: Resident of Union Territory of Puducherry for at least 5 years;Admitted through CENTAC counseling to government or private professional college
requiredDocuments: CENTAC allotment order;Residence / Nativity certificate;Tuition fee receipt;Aadhaar Card
applicationProcess: Apply online through the Puducherry Directorate of Higher and Technical Education portal;Submit attested copies to college principal;Department disburses fee directly to institution
source: Directorate of Higher and Technical Education, Government of Puducherry

name: Tamil Nadu Pudhumai Penn Scheme
description: State financial initiative providing monthly monetary support of Rs. 1,000 to female students pursuing higher education who studied in government schools.
benefits: Monthly assistance of Rs. 1,000 transferred directly to bank account until degree completion;Empowers girl students from disadvantaged backgrounds to pursue higher degrees
eligibility: Female students enrolled in higher education;Must have studied from classes VI to XII in Tamil Nadu government schools
requiredDocuments: School study certificates from Class 6 to 12;Aadhaar Card;College admission ID card and bonafide certificate;Bank passbook copy
applicationProcess: Register through the official Pudhumai Penn portal or through college nodal officer;Institutional verification of school records;Direct credit of allowance via DBT
source: Department of Social Welfare and Women Empowerment, Government of Tamil Nadu
